sections.text: NHS managers have warned that up to 20 smaller consultant-led maternity units across England may need to shut. sections.text: Health bosses argue consolidating services will improve safety and care quality for mothers and babies. sections.text: Historian Nini Rodgers died at the age of 86. Throughout a four-decade career at Queen’s University Belfast, she taught thousands of students and championed part-time night degrees. gist: Mayor Zohran Mamdani urged New Yorkers to challenge the rapid rollout of artificial intelligence.
Mamdani criticised federal inaction, accusing national authorities of allowing technology firms to self-regulate.
New York City has introduced school AI bans and disclosure rules for property listings.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: At an event at Webster Hall, Mayor Zohran Mamdani and activist Ilana Glazer discussed artificial intelligence. Mamdani urged New Yorkers to reject the idea that AI adoption is inevitable and argued that public officials must hold technology firms accountable.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Mamdani criticised the federal government for failing to regulate the sector, noting that national policy largely lets companies self-regulate. In response to risks, New York City has already barred AI from elementary and middle schools and mandated disclosures for AI-generated real estate listings.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Mamdani called for a different accountability framework following the current federal administration, as AI companies including Anthropic and OpenAI prepare to enter public markets.
